description: 'outer' renders from state and is generated. The document it renders to contains a nested 'use: inline:' child ('inner') whose own unrendered template names its tool provider as 'sh{{!c}}ell' -- a Mustache comment tag that renders to nothing, so the final provider is 'shell', but the unrendered text never literally said so. A scalar difference at a security-sensitive field (here, 'provider') always counts as generated, so 'inner' is refused for its params.allowed_commands the same as any other generated shell effect -- nothing runs.
